steps.en: Build and open the native app on a supported Mac
steps.zh: 在受支持的 Mac 上构建并打开应用

steps.en: Choose Download Model and a destination
steps.zh: 点击下载模型并选择目录

steps.en: Streams the pinned checkpoint into a verified .gturbo directory
steps.zh: 把固定检查点流式重排成已校验的模型目录

steps.en: Load the model, enter a prompt and choose Generate
steps.zh: 加载模型，输入提示词并点击生成

steps.en: Reads selected experts from SSD and returns generated text
steps.zh: 从 SSD 读取选中的专家，返回生成文字

value.en: Use the pinned Gemma model without keeping all expert weights resident
value.zh: 无需让全部专家权重常驻，也能运行固定 Gemma 模型
